pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding (milling) of dried pine needles in an electric blender and sieving through a mesh of 20 mesh size.
Steam explosion involving autoclaving of pine needles in flasks plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 min.
Chemical acid treatment using HCl (part of an acid-base-acid sequence) with a 30 min cycle until the wash out liquid was clear.
Chemical alkali treatment using NaOH (part of an acid-base-acid sequence) with a 30 min cycle until the wash out liquid was clear.
